list.name: run_id
list.label: Run ID
list.query: SELECT DISTINCT run_id FROM ofm_load_test_runs ORDER BY started_at DESC LIMIT 100

targets.rawSql: SELECT multiIf(verdict='PASS',1,verdict='DEGRADED',2,0) AS value FROM ofm_load_test_runs WHERE run_id='$run_id' ORDER BY started_at DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT checks_failed FROM ofm_load_test_runs WHERE run_id='$run_id' ORDER BY started_at DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT checks_total AS value FROM ofm_load_test_runs WHERE run_id='$run_id' ORDER BY started_at DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT p95_duration_ms FROM ofm_load_test_runs WHERE run_id='$run_id' ORDER BY started_at DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT kafka_lag FROM ofm_load_test_runs WHERE run_id='$run_id' ORDER BY started_at DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT projection_pending FROM ofm_load_test_runs WHERE run_id='$run_id' ORDER BY started_at DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT projection_failures FROM ofm_load_test_runs WHERE run_id='$run_id' ORDER BY started_at DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT run_id, scenario_id, architecture, profile, status, started_at, finished_at, checks_total, checks_failed, http_requests, http_failed, p95_duration_ms, kafka_lag, projection_pending, projection_failures, dlq_count, recovery_time_ms FROM ofm_load_test_runs WHERE architecture IN ($architecture) ORDER BY started_at DESC LIMIT 100
SELECT started_at AS time, p95_duration_ms AS p95_ms, http_requests FROM ofm_load_test_runs WHERE run_id='$run_id' ORDER BY time

WITH (SELECT projection_audit_json FROM ofm_load_test_runs WHERE run_id='$run_id' ORDER BY started_at DESC LIMIT 1) AS audit SELECT entity, if(JSONExtractRaw(JSONExtractRaw(audit, 'entities'), entity) = '', NULL, JSONExtractInt(JSONExtractRaw(JSONExtractRaw(audit, 'entities'), entity), 'microservice_count')) AS microservice_count, if(JSONExtractRaw(JSONExtractRaw(audit, 'entities'), entity) = '', NULL, JSONExtractInt(JSONExtractRaw(JSONExtractRaw(audit, 'entities'), entity), 'monolith_count')) AS monolith_count, if(JSONExtractRaw(JSONExtractRaw(audit, 'entities'), entity) = '', NULL, JSONExtractInt(JSONExtractRaw(JSONExtractRaw(audit, 'entities'), entity), 'mapping_count')) AS mapping_count, if(JSONExtractRaw(JSONExtractRaw(audit, 'entities'), entity) = '', NULL, JSONExtractInt(JSONExtractRaw(JSONExtractRaw(audit, 'entities'), entity), 'outbox_published')) AS outbox_published, if(JSONExtractRaw(JSONExtractRaw(audit, 'entities'), entity) = '', NULL, JSONExtractInt(JSONExtractRaw(JSONExtractRaw(audit, 'entities'), entity), 'outbox_pending')) AS outbox_pending, if(JSONExtractRaw(JSONExtractRaw(audit, 'entities'), entity) = '', NULL, JSONExtractInt(JSONExtractRaw(JSONExtractRaw(audit, 'entities'), entity), 'mismatches')) AS mismatches FROM (SELECT arrayJoin(['user','auth_credentials','registration','gig','gig_package','gig_question','gig_media','file','order','order_gig_snapshot','order_question_snapshot','order_requirement_answer','order_checkout_session','order_delivery','order_delivery_file','order_attachment','order_revision_request','order_dispute','chat','chat_message','review','payment_intent','payment_webhook_event','connect_account','payment_release','payment_transfer','payment_refund','order_saga','registration_saga']) AS entity)
SELECT timestamp, service, level, operation, message, trace_id, span_id, raw FROM ofm_logs WHERE test_run_id='$run_id' ORDER BY timestamp DESC LIMIT 500

WITH run_window AS (SELECT min(started_at) AS run_started, max(finished_at) AS run_finished FROM ofm_load_test_runs WHERE run_id='$run_id') SELECT timestamp, service, extract(message, 'msg=\"CHECK_FAILED ([^\"]+)\"') AS check_name, if(message != '', message, msg) AS details, raw FROM ofm_logs WHERE service='k6' AND timestamp >= (SELECT run_started FROM run_window) AND timestamp <= (SELECT run_finished FROM run_window) AND positionCaseInsensitiveUTF8(message, 'CHECK_FAILED') > 0 UNION ALL SELECT timestamp, service, operation AS check_name, if(message != '', message, msg) AS details, raw FROM ofm_logs WHERE test_run_id='$run_id' AND service!='k6' AND (positionCaseInsensitiveUTF8(message, 'CHECK_FAILED') > 0 OR positionCaseInsensitiveUTF8(msg, 'CHECK_FAILED') > 0) ORDER BY timestamp DESC LIMIT 500
SELECT quantileExact(0.99)(duration_ms) AS value FROM ofm_logs WHERE test_run_id='$run_id' AND duration_ms>0
